test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.**

(Ø = No article)

________ year ago, Arihant decided to join ________ NCC.
solution:
The correct answer is: **A; the**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• "**A**" is used before a singular noun
